channel.title: The Kyiv Independent - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Kyiv Independent (kyivindependent.com)

item.title: Russia targets Dnipropetrovsk miners 2nd day in a row after deadly bus attack
item.description: Russia struck a coal mine operated by Ukraine's biggest private energy firm, DTEK, in Dnipropetrovsk Oblast for the second time over the past day, the company said on Feb. 2.

item.title: As temperatures plunge, Kyiv braces for Russia's next mass attack on energy infrastructure
item.description: "They are trying to kill us with hunger and cold," one Kyiv resident told the Kyiv Independent.

item.title: Balloons from Belarus enter Poland's airspace for 3rd night in a row
item.description: After spotting "objects resembling balloons" on radar, Polish military and security forces quickly intercepted them and detained individuals suspected of involvement, the Polish military said.

item.title: Trump to reduce tariffs on India, says Modi agreed to stop buying Russian oil
item.description: "This will help END THE WAR in Ukraine," Trump said on Truth Social after holding a phone call with Modi, adding that the Indian leader agreed "to buy much more (oil) from the United States and, potentially, Venezuela."

item.title: Trump's envoy Witkoff to reportedly join Russia-Ukraine peace talks in Abu Dhabi
item.description: Witkoff is then reportedly expected to meet Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi and other officials in Istanbul on Feb. 6 to discuss details of a potential nuclear deal amid heightened U.S.-Iran tensions.

item.title: Ukraine war latest: Russian forces trying to 'bypass and infiltrate' Vovchansk in Kharkiv Oblast, military says
item.description: Live coverage of Russia’s war against Ukraine with breaking news and frontline updates, updated 10 times today. Russian troops are trying to "bypass and infiltrate" the destroyed town of Vovchansko in northeastern Kharkiv Oblast, and the situation is "frankly difficult," Viktor Tregubov, a spokesman for Ukraine's Joint Forces in charge of the area, said on Feb. 2.

item.title: How to keep an elephant and a gorilla warm during Kyiv's coldest winter of the full-scale war

item.title: Ukraine names Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps as terrorist organization
item.description: "Ukraine has not forgotten any of the thousands of Shaheds that attack our cities and villages, our people," President Volodymyr Zelensky said on Feb. 2.

item.title: 'Moral degenerate' — Ukraine slams FIFA president for supporting Russia's return
item.description: "Six-hundred seventy-nine Ukrainian girls and boys will never be able to play football — Russia killed them," Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha said after FIFA President Gianni Infantino backed lifting the ban on Russian athletes.

item.title: 'Russians chose a freezing February night' — Damaged buildings, casualties reported as Russia resumes large-scale strikes on Kyiv
item.description: Russian forces launched a mass ballistic missile and drone attack on Kyiv overnight on Feb. 3, striking multiple residential buildings across the city and injuring at least three people, officials said.
